note: Text from the [Text Creation Partnership's keyboarded edition](https://github.com/textcreationpartnership/A16068) (EEBO-TCP A16068), converted with `scripts/tcp-to-articles.php`. Spelling, u/v and i/j as printed; long s printed as s; line-end hyphens rejoined; italics mark words set in roman or italic type within the black letter. • marks a letter and 〈◊〉 a word or more that TCP could not read. Each page begins at its folio number in square brackets, which links to that page of the [microfilm scan](https://archive.org/details/bim_early-english-books-1475-1640_the-secretes-of-the-reve_ruscelli-girolamo_1558) on the Internet Archive. Not yet checked against the scans.
